_comment: Descriptor of the rev A haptics coupon (slot S5 only, wide), written from its captured design (keyboard/hardware/design/sheets/coupon_haptics.py, DESCRIPTOR_FACTS and the parts notes, 2026-11-27) and its netlist. Not built: the currents are the design's estimates (placeholder_fields). tests/test_rules.py compares it with DESCRIPTOR_FACTS.
notes: S5 only: G0-G5 on TIM1 (INHA-INHC on CH1-CH3, INLA-INLC on CH1N-CH3N, held high as enables in 3x PWM), IRQ_N = DRV8316 nFAULT on TIM1_BKIN, the 2 A 5 V rail, AN1-AN3 on ADC4 (SPEC §2, §4.4)

AN0 = MT6701 OUT (analog angle, ratiometric to VDD = +3V3) through R17 100 ohm: R_src 130 ohm max (100 + R_OUT 15-30 ohm), C_L <= 1 nF (MT6701 Rev. 1.9 §5, the design's reading). Angle scaling 0-360 deg over the full output range is an assumption (placeholder_fields)

AN1-AN3 = DRV8316 SOA/SOB/SOC through R12-R14 330 ohm (SLVSF16B §9.2.1.1.6): R_src 330 ohm. Declared in volts at the pin (gain 3.3 V per full scale, VDDA nominal), not amps: SOx = AVDD/2 + G x I with G set over SPI (CSA_GAIN) and AVDD the DRV8316's own LDO, so the coupon driver converts; not ratiometric to the slot's +3V3. CLoad: 'supports only capacitive load at output' with no value stated (§8.3.11): 0

+3V3: about 13 mA idle, about 160 mA peak with the LRA (the design's estimates: MT6701 14 mA max, the LRA's 3.3 V / 24 ohm = 0.14 A peak through the DRV2605L). +5V: DRV8316 4-6 mA awake and idle plus the motor; max_ma is S5's 2 A rule; typ_ma 300 is a guess for a 5-15 ohm gimbal motor
Bulk: +3V3 36 uF and +5V 284 uF by the design (C19 22 uF sits behind the buck's 22 ohm, so the header sum is 262 uF), within S5's 470 uF rule

SPI: DRV8316 mode 1, SCLK period >= 100 ns (10 MHz); MT6701 SSI mode 1, CLK period >= 64 ns: spi.max_khz 10000 is the lower. Both reach MISO through SN74LVC1G125 buffers enabled by their chip selects (SPEC §4.9)

I2C on the coupon's channel: DRV2605L 0x5A (enable it through the expander before any register write), CAP1206 0x28 (polled), TCA9534 0x20 (U16). The TCA9534 is an 8-bit expander with a register map unlike the TCA9535's: format 1.0 has no part ID for it, so 'other'
Power +3V3 first, then +5V: nFAULT must be pulled above 2.2 V when the DRV8316 powers up (sheets/coupon_haptics.py)
